name: Dollar Tree, Inc.
summary: Dollar Tree, Inc. operates retail discount stores under the Dollar Tree and Dollar Tree Canada brands in the United States and Canada. The company offers consumable merchandise comprising everyday consumables, such as household paper and chemicals, food, candy, health, personal care products, and frozen and refrigerated food; variety merchandise consisting of toys, durable housewares, gifts, stationery, party goods, greeting cards, softlines, arts and crafts supplies, and other items; and seasonal goods, including Christmas, Easter, Halloween, and Valentine's Day merchandise. The company was founded in 1986 and is based in Chesapeake, Virginia.

moat_type: Proprietary IP, Customer Relationships & Market Presence
moat_durability: Competitive position sustained by product quality and distribution scale.
tam_description: Global Discount Stores addressable market expanding at ~6-9% CAGR through 2030.

Creedon Jr. provides vital strategic execution and direction. The company targets a massive addressable runway (Consumer Defensive expanding with secular adoption.). Financially, DLTR trades at a trailing P/E of 13.98 (Forward P/E 14.66), P/S of 1.08, and PEG of 1.42, supported by leverage of D/E 2.24 and annual Free Cash Flow of $1.05B. Valuation triangulation indicates a DCF fair value of $226.56 and Wall Street mean target of $136.4 (Consensus: HOLD). Technical configuration reflects Pullback Opportunity (30-48) with a 20/200 SMA trend alignment. **Conclusion & Stance:** HOLD / MONITOR SETUP. Prime accumulation window is identified at $114.07 - $117.49, targeting long-term upside to $141.33 with disciplined risk defined at $100.38.
